name: 一号教学楼
frame: Building-local: origin = portal centre on the central block's front wall at the ground-floor level (±0.00); +x campus east along the facade, +y out of the front facade (towards the North Gate), +z up. Placement in the twin frame: twin/data/site.json.

evidence.tags: surveyed | public-map | estimated | invented | documented (same vocabulary as data/campus-credibility.json)

sources.esri: assets/cinematic/aligned/courtyard.jpg (Esri World Imagery export, 0.55 m/px, capture date unknown). Roof outlines read in the twin frame; relief displacement of roofs removed with a per-metre-of-height shift of (+0.335, -0.53) m in twin x/y, calibrated so that the central roof and the two rear links are symmetric about the axis and the central front eave sits 1.2 m in front of the wall
sources.osm: OpenStreetMap via Overture 2026-11-18.0: building way 1165596682 (front edge at y = +1.3..+2.4, rotated +0.7 deg against the axis road), axis road, 太湖石 artwork polygon
sources.aerial: assets/images/campus/aerial_campus.jpg (school website, date unknown): bay counts (6 per wing), storey counts, roof forms, tower tops, porch roofs, forecourt
sources.front: assets/images/campus/campus_yihao.jpg: central block (3 bays), towers (granite to the 5th storey, arched window in the 6th), porch, plinth
sources.portal: assets/images/web/jiaoxuelou-1600.jpg (= campus/scenery_11.jpg): portal with 1923, stepped door frame, canopy on white columns, side porches with granite side portals, ground floor open through to the courtyard, wing colonnade, window design
sources.flank: assets/images/campus/scenery_13.jpg: granite colonnade of storeys 1-2 along the east wing, entablature, upper pilasters, hedge, side-plaza paving, overhanging Terminalia canopy
sources.hero: assets/images/web/hero-2560.jpg (North Gate looking south along the axis, keystone-corrected, level camera, horizon row 1075 from the converging road kerbs): central window grid read to 1-2 px; storey pitch = 0.478 x central bay (s3-s6 window tops 908/850/792/736 px, bays 120.5 px); towers cover 0.59 m of each outer central bay; porch floor row 1083 px

ground_floor.basis: 3 risers porch->plaza and 4 risers plaza->forecourt road counted on jiaoxuelou-1600 / aerial, 0.15 m each (generic riser)

storeys.basis: upper storey = 0.478 x central bay (hero-2560 and campus_yihao agree: 0.478 / 0.47); central bay 7.09 m from the aerial (central roof eave corners lie over the tower centre lines) and the Esri eave width 26.6 m; ground storey from the porch floor (row 1083) to the 3rd-storey sills (row 941.7) on hero-2560 = 8.31 m with 0.9 m sills. Uncertainty about +/-0.15 m per storey, dominated by the absolute scale.

central.basis: 3 bays of 7.09 m on the axis (window centres 0, +/-7.09); window width 0.656 bay, height 0.335 storey-pitch (hero-2560); visible front between the granite towers 2.84 bays = 20.1 m; walls behind the towers +/-12.1 from the Esri eave width 26.6 m minus 1.2 m overhang

towers.basis: tower = 0.91 central bay (campus_yihao 147/159 px; aerial 120/135 px); inner face 0.59 m inside the outer central bays (hero-2560); outer face +/-16.5 meets the wing roofs (Esri +/-16.3). Granite cornice spans the 5th-storey windows (hero-2560 rows 798-817 vs window 792-825; campus_yihao the same), arched window above it through the 6th storey, louvred box in the 7th

wings.basis: 6 window bays per wing (aerial, both wings); bay 5.25 m; window 0.62 bay, height 0.6 storey (jiaoxuelou-1600, local ratios); granite entablature about 1 m deep over the two-storey colonnade

pavilions.basis: end roofs 11.0-11.5 m wide x 18 m deep incl. eaves, ridge running front-back (Esri, aerial); overall roof length 116 m eave to eave; narrow front with one column of small windows (aerial)

portal.basis: hero-2560: portal 157 px wide at 17.8 px/m (5.6 m in front of the facade) = 8.8 m, opening 5.0 m; terrace/top at 8.0 m; lintel and 1923 from jiaoxuelou-1600 proportions

canopy.basis: hero-2560: eave corners at rows 893 (10.6 m), ridge row 852 (about 13 m), eaves 218 px = 12.1 m

side.basis: hero-2560: red shed roofs rows 943-960 (8.2 -> 7.0 m) reaching the towers; side portal cap rows 993-1000 (4.9-5.1 m), opening 43 px = 2.4 m wide, head at 4.0 m

through_hall.basis: the courtyard and the next building are visible through the portal on jiaoxuelou-1600: open ground-floor passage

links.basis: two white flat-roofed links to the next building on the Esri layer, symmetric about the axis after lean correction; length beyond 13 m and their facades unknown

rear.basis: No photograph of the rear (courtyard) facades was available; a corridor facade with windows is assumed.

central.basis: aerial / campus_yihao: hipped, upturned corners, white fascia, ridges and curled ridge ends

open_questions: Absolute scale of the facade rests on the Esri eave width (26.6 m) and the aerial reading that the central eave corners sit over the tower centre lines; a single taped dimension (e.g. a central bay or the portal) would fix every storey height.
Long axis rotated +0.7 deg (OSM outline) to +1.2 deg (roof eaves) against the axis-road bearing; not applied.
OSM puts the front wall 1.3-2.4 m further north than the lean-corrected Esri reading used for the origin.
Top-storey windows read taller (2.35 m) than the others (1.93 m) on hero-2560; modelled, not confirmed elsewhere.
Rear facades, link facades and the courtyard are not photographed.

materials.basis: colours read by eye from the photographs; PBR factors are reference values
